notes.title: Experience update and optimization
notes.content:
Experience optimization:
Optimized the art in the lobby and in the game, added casual background music, and optimized the experience.

notes.title: Experience update and optimization
notes.content:
Game difficulty adjustment:
  Seeing the difficulty of friend operations and players' reactions, we made some adjustments to the difficulty of the game, increased the number of grasses in some levels, adjusted the terrain, and weakened the guardian attributes in hard mode, reduced the observation range by 15%, and moved the speed. Reduce it by 10%, hoping to have a better experience for new players.

Bug fixes:
  Fixed the bug that the leaderboards were not recorded after customs clearance

notes.title: Experience small update
notes.content:
In order for new players to have a better experience, there is now two seconds of invincibility when resurrected. The resurrection invincible time gained by the blessing will add up.

Optimized the problem that the new blessing interface is affected by the mouse.

Questions and suggestions are welcome to put forward ːsteamhappyː
